# The Missing Piece

> Browser-based TikTok LIVE interactive games and daily solo word, trivia, and visual puzzles built for creators, livestream hosts, and puzzle players at https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun.

## Overview

The Missing Piece (`https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun`) is a free web gaming platform offering two main collections:
1. **TikTok Interactive Games** — Real-time audience-driven word and puzzle games with transparent browser-source overlays for TikTok LIVE Studio and OBS Studio so livestream viewers can play directly through chat commands.
2. **Solo Games** — 12 free, browser-playable daily and endless word, trivia, crossword, and supermarket price puzzles featuring unified Google/Email accounts, daily streaks, and public leaderboards.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/): Platform overview and featured interactive/solo game collections.
- [Solo Games Hub](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games): Directory of all 12 solo puzzles with unified accounts and public leaderboards.
- [TikTok Interactive Games](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games): Directory of creator livestream games and chat-driven overlays.
- [All Interactive Overlays](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/overlays): Combined live overlay wall for livestream setup.

## Solo Games

- [MP Colossal — 200×200 Giant Crossword Atlas](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/mpcolossal): A 40,000-square pan-and-zoom crossword atlas with 25 themed quest sectors, 4,100+ clues, Atlas Radar minimap, 3-tier hints, and 12×12 Stream Layout.
- [Cruciverbalist Daily Crossword](https://cruci.missingpiecepuzzles.fun/): Daily 20×20 and 8×8 thematic crosswords mixing standard and cryptic clues.
- [Missing Rebus](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/rebus): Archive of 733+ visual wordplay rebus challenges, printable worksheet grids, and timed sprint mode.
- [Squared — Daily Word Grid](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/squared): Daily swipeable letter grid across 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 boards with board rotation.
- [Thematix — Word Association](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/thematix): Daily alphabetical theme-linked word association puzzles with custom puzzle builder.
- [DeStack — Word Unstacking](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/destack): 3D layered letter-tower unstacking puzzles across Standard and Hard modes.
- [Unolingo — 26-Letter Crossword](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/unolingo): Zero-clue 10×10 deduction crossword using every letter A–Z once, with a 183-day archive.
- [WiKirecTangled (Solo)](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/wikirec): Trace 8-connected paths across a 3D keycap board to uncover hidden Wikipedia article titles.
- [WikiContexto (Solo)](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/wikicon): Redacted Wikipedia article discovery using semantic closeness rankings.
- [MP Search — Daily Word Search](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/mpsearch): Tactile 10×10 letterpress word search puzzles with a 368-day archive.
- [MP Difference — Spot the Difference](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/mpdifference): Side-by-side illustrated visual spot-the-difference game with a 2.2× optical loupe across 8 worlds.
- [TEKSCOdle — UK Supermarket Price Guesser](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/solo-games/tekscodle): Price 1-item, 3-item, and 5-item UK supermarket baskets in Daily Basket, Endless Practice, and Quick Play modes.

## TikTok Interactive Live Games

- [Crowdle](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/crowdle): Crowd-played live Wordle battle for livestream chat.
- [WiKirecTangled Live](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/wikirec): Viewer-driven 8-connected Wikipedia word discovery with transparent overlay.
- [WikiContexto Live](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/wikicon): Live chat article decryption game with transparent overlay.
- [Squared Interactive](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/squared): Audience letter-grid word hunt for TikTok LIVE Studio.
- [Lexi Tiles Live](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/lexi): Real-time anagram tile challenge for livestream audiences.
- [DeStack Interactive](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/destack): Chat-assisted 3D word unstacking tower.
- [MP Search Interactive](https://missingpiecepuzzles.fun/interactive-games/mpsearch): Real-time audience word search overlay for TikTok LIVE.
